grade.headline: Google Pixel Tablet: Clarity B, a good wall panel for typical dashboards, with a camera. Held back by large dashboards: a camera takes 2.1 s to show its first frame and shows 100% of its frames; its stalls weren't measured in 3 of 3 run(s); the main thread is blocked for 0.9 s after the view is drawn. Provisional: heavy: 3 camera run(s) whose receiver counts left up to 1.0 s of the window out (getStats answered late): stalls n/a, not measured; not everything was measured.

causes: Memory isn't the limit (1279 of 3721 MB).
